name: tab-bar
title: Tab bar
description: The bottom navigation of a phone app: four or five destinations as an icon over a label, with the safe-area inset, the current one marked with aria-current. The app-view page places it last on phones.
docs: Needs the Atom63 token stack and recipes in your CSS, as an @atom63/create app sets up: https://system.atom63.io/patterns/pattern-templates
